TestCase Description: Verify that the application URL redirects to the login screen.
PreCondition: The application URL is accessible in a browser.
TestSteps: 1. Navigate to https://app.vwo.com/. 2. Observe the redirected page.
Expected Result: The application URL redirects to https://app.vwo.com/#/login.

TestCase Description: Verify successful login with valid credentials.
PreCondition: A valid registered test account is available.
TestSteps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Enter valid credentials. 3. Submit the login request.
Expected Result: The account is authenticated successfully. Inference (low confidence): the user proceeds to an authenticated application state.

PreCondition: A registered account has 2FA enabled and valid primary credentials are available.
TestSteps: 1. Submit valid primary credentials. 2. Enter an incorrect second-factor code. 3. Confirm the login attempt.
Expected Result: Insufficient information to determine the required validation behavior; however 2FA is traceable to the PRD Security requirement.

Test Data: Valid registered account; valid second-factor code
TestCase Description: Verify successful completion of the 2FA login flow.
PreCondition: A registered account has 2FA enabled and valid primary and second-factor credentials are available.
TestSteps: 1. Submit valid primary credentials. 2. Enter the valid second-factor code. 3. Confirm the login attempt.
Expected Result: The login flow should be completed successfully. Inference (low confidence): 2FA behavior is not detailed in the PRD.

PreCondition: A valid registered test account is available.
TestSteps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Submit valid credentials. 3. Submit again before the first authentication response completes.
Expected Result: Insufficient information to determine whether duplicate submissions are prevented or handled.

PreCondition: No authenticated session exists and a protected application URL is known.
TestSteps: 1. Open the browser without an authenticated session. 2. Navigate directly to a protected application URL.
Expected Result: Insufficient information to determine whether the user is redirected or the protected resource is blocked.

Test Data: Valid login using one configured role
TestCase Description: Verify role-based access after successful authentication.
PreCondition: A test account with a defined role is available.
TestSteps: 1. Login using the configured test account. 2. Access capabilities permitted for that role. 3. Attempt access to a capability outside that role.
Expected Result: The role-based access control requirement is satisfied; exact permitted capabilities and UI restrictions are not defined in the PRD.

Test Data: Valid login followed by logout or session termination
TestCase Description: Verify termination of an authenticated login session.
PreCondition: A valid authenticated session is available.
TestSteps: 1. Login successfully. 2. Use the application logout or session termination control if available. 3. Attempt to reopen a protected application URL.
Expected Result: Insufficient information to determine the available logout mechanism or session termination behavior.

TestCase Description: Verify that an authentication activity is recorded in activity logs.
PreCondition: A valid test account is available and activity logging is enabled.
TestSteps: 1. Login successfully. 2. Access an activity-log view if available. 3. Search for the authentication activity.
Expected Result: Activity logging is required by the PRD Security category; exact log fields and interface are not defined.

Test Data: Valid login in different supported browser sessions
PreCondition: A valid registered test account and multiple browser environments are available.
TestSteps: 1. Open the login page in one browser. 2. Login using valid credentials. 3. Repeat the login in another browser.
Expected Result: The login flow should remain accessible across the selected browsers. Inference (low confidence): cross-browser QA is a stated capability but supported browser names are not defined.

Test Data: Valid login under a normal enterprise visitor load
TestCase Description: Verify that login remains responsive under normal enterprise load.
PreCondition: The enterprise test environment and a valid test account are available.
TestSteps: 1. Establish a measured baseline. 2. Submit valid login attempts under the defined normal enterprise load. 3. Repeat the login attempt after the load is increased.
Expected Result: Insufficient information to determine the login-specific performance threshold; the PRD only defines a 2-second response requirement for editing workflows.
